units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 13:8">Kel. XIII, 8</cite> <he>מ׳ של פישתן</he> hackle for flax.

<cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Metsia 4:4">Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. IV, 4</cite> <he>מ׳ שיש בו דרבן</he> (an iron) comb to which a sting is attached (an instrument of torture cmp. <cite ref="Q01564"><he>פַּרְגָּל</he></cite>).

senses.gloss: an indented attachment to a vessel or a plant &c. Ib. 9 שלשלת חִבּוּר על המ׳ a lamp-chain is considered as joined to ‘the comb’.
